symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of an array, which is the number of coordinates in each address.
symbols.quote: An array with $D$ axes has $D$ coordinates in each address, one per axis.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis $i$: the number of values that coordinate of an address takes.
symbols.quote: The length $t_i$ of axis $i$ is the number of values its coordinate takes.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate of an address along axis $i$, an integer with $0 \le x_i < t_i$.
symbols.quote: Along axis $i$ an address has a coordinate $x_i$ with $0 \le x_i < t_i$.
